_comment: Compatibility list for https://unhingedsoftware.github.io/kirie/. One entry per tested item. `status`: works | partial | broken | asset (an effect or preset used to build wallpapers, not a wallpaper itself); partial and broken must say what is wrong in `notes`. Screenshots are optional and live at shots/<id>.jpg -- they must be kirie's own render (`kirie --bg <dir> --screenshot out.png`), not the Workshop preview art. Run `python3 site/validate.py` before opening a pull request; CI runs the same check.

wallpapers.title: Moonlight
wallpapers.notes: Nine particle systems; the heaviest scene tested.

wallpapers.title: Starscape
wallpapers.notes: Very dark by design; fades in over several seconds.

wallpapers.title: ION | Audio Responsive Wallpaper
wallpapers.notes: Needs a web build. Audio reactivity and MPRIS now-playing both work; --screenshot of web items is CEF-only.

wallpapers.title: Gradient generator
wallpapers.notes: An effect preset wallpapers build on, not a wallpaper. kirie lists it as type asset and skips it in pickers.
